ap_definition: Ultralytics 101-point interpolated single-class AP at IoU 0.5; mAP50_95 averages IoU thresholds 0.50:0.05:0.95. This differs from Method 1 all-points AP interpolation.
precision_recall_definition: Ultralytics validation precision and recall at its best-F1 operating point, not necessarily visualization confidence 0.25.
timing_definition: inference_ms: synchronized predict() including preprocessing, forward pass, NMS/postprocessing, and CPU box transfer. model_inference_ms: Ultralytics forward-pass timing only. processing_ms: image/label loading, predict(), red/green drawing, and image saving. Timings exclude model loading, three warm-up calls, and the separate AP validation run.
visualization: test contains all original filenames; red boxes are predictions with confidence >= 0.25; green boxes are ground-truth birds, drawn on top.
path_definition: Model and dataset paths are relative to the repository root.
